configuration_transfer.summary: Handbook dimensions and 1928 illustrations are provisionally applied to 1919–1920 production; this is not a serial-number-specific fit.

photo_perspective.summary: SNL Plates 1,3,4,10 are photographs, including a perspective top view. They cannot supply global orthographic scale; retained for visual checks only.

shoe_profile.summary: Printed shoe width/pitch and SNL composition are retained in two full 78-unit static loops. Plate pressing, lap forging, pin/bush fits and installed rivet/cotter forms remain bounded reconstructions. Nominal track self-contact and hull contact are checked; wheel engagement and continuous articulation remain unqualified.

roller_profile.summary: Roller OD/width and tube envelope are printed. Waist profile, bore fit, exact axial placement and edge radii are estimates. Shaft, bushings, U bolts and spring kit are outside rotating-unit scope.

ring_section.summary: HB 141 gives 3.531 in ring diameter without clear bore convention; SNL gives 12.56 in stock length. Pilot interprets diameter as bore and adds provisional tube grooves. Exact retained-ring/groove fit remains unresolved.

support_joint.summary: M2078 callout locates support on Plate 2, but its full sweep and section lack dimensions. Model is a labeled local straight coupon with illustrative mating plate and unthreaded fasteners, not a released M2078 replacement.

blockout.summary: Hull and upper structure are reference envelopes traced from Plate 2. Sponson depth/footprint and widths are provisional; armor segmentation, equipment and detailed production panel differences deferred.

placements.summary: Pilot assembly stations are selected for clear representative layout; wheel axes come from the foldout. Symmetric placements do not prove historical handedness or complete vehicle quantities.

calibration_residuals.summary: Conditional image scaling uses handbook dimensions. Independent wheel/turret checks may disagree; reported residuals limit precision and are not suppressed.

research_backlog.summary: Next: production fuel tanks and Ball & Ball; Bijur units; tank/aircraft engine interfaces; SH642B spring conflict; missing installation drawings. No proprietary dimensions inferred from modern replacements.

layout_only.summary: Initial layout representations establish subsystem envelopes and interfaces. They do not count as completed component definitions.

transverse_layout.summary: Track spacing and upper-structure widths are printed. Most equipment widths and transverse stations are bounded assumptions pending additional sections.

engine_layout.summary: Engine and transmission longitudinal profiles are traced from SNL Plate2; tank-specific port locations, exact mounts and full component surfaces remain unresolved.

fuel_layout.summary: Three production 50-gallon tanks selected. HB30–32 supports side-by-side rear placement, transferred provisionally. Traced envelope does not infer capacity or shell geometry.

upper_shape.summary: HB35 printed main enclosure 3136.9 x 1028.7 x 571.5 mm now controls the plate shell. Its unchanged SNL2 trace is about 2766.4 mm long and 658.0 mm high. Main shell center and base registration come from that trace. The difference is retained in the validation report and fixed-calibration overlay; no image refit is performed.

track_outline.summary: Both tracks use 78 source-composed units at printed pitch with cyclic pin closure. The source outer guide is offset/rounded; a bounded smooth upper-transition correction clears the developing hull before uniform closure scale and ground registration. Image calibration is unchanged. Wheel/rail support engagement and historical source-outline fit remain open.

visual_fit.summary: Overlays use fixed recorded calibration, not optimization against rendered edges. Pixel differences are review prompts, not pass/fail historical truth.

installation_interfaces.summary: Named layout axes and mounting frames are inferred within recorded bounds; no recovered original hole pattern is claimed.

track_fastener_form.summary: SNL specifies 11/16 in by 2 1/4 in button rivets and 1/4 in by 1 1/2 in split pins. Two equal spherical rivet buttons are assumed; forged foot thickness is derived to preserve untrimmed stock volume. Source underside shape and stack thickness are unverified. This supersedes the volume-inconsistent flush-tail trial. Bent round-section cotters also approximate the original split section.

drive_pitch_conflict.summary: HB130 explicitly gives road-wheel outside diameter 39.237 in and 35 teeth; HB133 gives 3.735 in pitch; HB119 gives a 9:37 roller-pinion reduction; HB137 specifies track pitch 11.154 in. These do not establish a consistent tooth/track-pin contact circle. Printed values remain intact while R02/R03 qualify a documented geometric approximation.

track_reverse_bend.summary: Two-unit trials show plate-to-plate contact at -10 degrees reverse bend (about 282 mm3), while sampled -5, 0, 10, 20, 30 and 35 degree positions are clear. This is not a continuous permitted range. R03 must determine actual route angles and refine the pressing/overlap where required.

idler_axis.summary: Visual reinspection of SNL Plate2 locates the idler adjusting-shaft center near [194,339], superseding the provisional [163,350]. The prior axis was about 187 mm too far forward. The corrected source datum remains independent of the solved track curve.

upper_plate_reconstruction.summary: HB35 controls upper enclosure overall length, width, height and armor thickness. SNL7 and HB30 control identifiable plate topology and handed openings. Undimensioned plan chamfers, rear rake/roof bend, apertures, seams and joints are bounded approximations. Roof bends are planar miters pending formed-radius evidence. Angles, hinges, port covers, rivets and fittings remain unmodeled; all upper components are partial.

hull_plate_reconstruction.summary: Individual standard hull shell plates replace central/track-frame envelopes. HB141 clear shell spacing is centered provisionally on each track center. Central fighting/engine floors span the outer walls, with narrower front/fuel portions. SNL7/1 establishes panel families; SNL2 outline is divided using inferred seam stations. Thicknesses, openings, floor seams, roof allocation and transverse transitions remain partial reconstructions. Angles, fasteners, formed edges and running-gear interfaces are pending.

hull_door_dimensions.summary: HB39 door 28.5 x 41.875 in is interpreted as the upper leaf; HB43 combined height 59.875 in gives an inferred 18 in lower leaf. HB43 opening width 29.875 in exceeds the modeled 28.5 in leaves plus 2 mm clearance by 32.925 mm. A framed-opening interpretation remains unproved. Both original dimensions and the residual are retained; no finished historical fit is claimed.

track_roof_clearance.summary: First integrated hull check found 80 track-part/roof overlaps across the two sides, concentrated around upper units 41–44. The prior closure route had no hull clearance constraint. A smooth, bounded vertical correction is now applied to the upper transition before the existing constant-pitch closure solve. Printed pitch/count and fixed image calibration remain unchanged; exact nominal contacts and both source-curve residuals are reported. Historical route and wheel/support engagement remain unqualified.

sponson_plate_reconstruction.summary: Standard individual sponson plates use HB35 thicknesses and the current SNL2 hull opening. Plan tapers, lower rake, seams, aperture limits and butt/miter joints are explicit approximations informed by SNL1/7. Native shells are hollow and partial; rotating gun shields, mounts, hinges, support gear, interior fittings, fasteners and exact seams remain open.

sponson_shield_hand.summary: M2764 is called right top intermediate in SNL154:003 and grouped port in HB227. Original SNL p154 scan confirms the wording. This first-100 reconstruction provisionally follows the later SNL installed assignment (right), with two top infill segments left and three right; it does not resolve historical handedness. Recheck assembly drawing before accepting.

sponson_floor_scope.summary: HB35 separately specifies floor 8 mm, forward floor 12 mm and aft floor 6 mm. Provisional mapping uses M2757 at 8, M2740 sloping forward bottom at 12, and M2749/M2741 aft sloping piece at 6. Actual seam locations and scope are unmeasured; retain partial status.

louver_reconstruction.summary: HB40 blade section interpreted provisionally as lengthwise-extruded sideways chevron: 63.5 mm roof-normal extent, 12.7 mm INSIDE bend and 6 mm normal stock. SNL4 supports lengthwise orientation but not section details. HB41 side frames interpreted as 6 mm flanged guards; frame/cover/packing contours and attachment dimensions are inferred. Blade repeats are evenly fitted with explicit edge allowance; air clearance does not qualify historical fit.

louver_quantity_conflict.summary: Working blade counts follow later SNL18: 34 M987 and 28 M994. HB40 gives 34/29, HB233/235 gives 39/29; retained DB issue HB_ERRATA_25. SNL133 allocates M997 68 inlet/54 outlet, HB66/56. Equal aperture width and different counts imply different provisional pitches, so one shared spacer geometry/attachment has NOT been established; distance/end pieces, saddles and fasteners remain pending rather than inventing a fit.

louver_guard_scope.summary: M982/M983 inlet sides and M990/M2108 outlet sides provisionally supply the HB41 tall guards. Separate low port outlet plate M989 is retained. Rear channels M2110/M2111, deflector plate, fishplates and packings require rear-roof reconstruction; they are not merged into the modeled louver sides. SNL two-per-side versus parenthetical two M1004 scope remains unresolved.

roller_stack.summary: R02 standard stacks transfer HB141/142 dimensions and SNL29 topology. Roller waists, upper hub width, bushing length, spring-plate contour, pin drilling, end flats and fastener envelopes remain explicit approximations. Threads, support angles/shaft clamping interfaces, end details and complete wheel/rail operation remain unqualified.

roller_spring_diameter.summary: Original HB141 prints 1-inch spring wire, 3.937-inch OUTSIDE spring diameter and 3.812-inch tube OD. Those cannot fit concentrically. Working geometry provisionally interprets 3.937 inches as INSIDE spring diameter (25.4 mm wire, 150.7998 mm OD), retaining literal printed OD as conflict; HB89/SNL29 show spring around tube. This is not a source correction or force/stress qualification.

roller_count_scope.summary: 58 lower base stacks INCLUDE 28 spring stacks (SNL gp / SURVEY_09); 30 are plain. HB142/237 adds two upper stacks with four M1341 rollers and shared components beyond the SNL lower totals. Upper transfer is provisional and validated separately; SNL quantities are not silently inflated. Upper M1410 plug retains a separate handbook survey identity; no equivalence to lower SNL Q52C is asserted.

roller_station_fit.summary: 29 lower SNL2 shaft picks per hand retain their source coordinates; Lower00 has a separately reported rearward X correction, while the other X stations remain fixed; Z follows conservative circular clearance against native track-link pin-segment capsules. The trace is not refitted; offsets and actual BRep gaps are reported. Upper station follows the rear roof-bend shaft feature at SNL2 pixel (1025,248), consistent with HB144 engine-room access; the original forward placeholder is superseded. Support angles and source-exact stations remain open.

roller_ring_reconstruction.summary: M1335 uses SNL165 3/16 x 3/8 x 12.56-inch stock; axial thickness is provisionally 3/16, radial depth 3/8, and developed split gap 3 mm. Mean radius preserves stock length. Tube grooves fit with explicit clearance. HB141 .187/.375/3.531-inch ring figures remain independently retained, not silently reconciled.

roller_roof_reliefs.summary: Upper rollers at the rear contour bend intersect the earlier flat/sloping track-housing roof reconstruction. Local wheel, tube and split-ring reliefs have 1 mm radial/axial allowance. Shaft bores follow all 60 station datums. These are explicit installation approximations, not source-exact opening contours. SH294A upper covers and source-exact support attachment remain pending; provisional M2092 upper angles are now populated. Forward roof clamp slots from the superseded trial placement are not retained. Local vertical upper staple-leg clearance holes (1 mm radial/axial allowance) in the rear roof follow the same stations; the +0.5 mm track-pitch trial exposed the need for this small clearance. These inferred holes do not establish the missing upper cover/support construction. The upper-support revision adds local 1 mm access relief around M2092 and its raised clamp through the rear roof only. These remove a demonstrated nut/roof overlap; their rectangular boundary is an explicit reconstruction, pending original cover and attachment drawings.

roller_support_interface.summary: HB141 describes pins suspended by support angles and U bolts, with end flats seating against the angle toe. HB88/89 and SNL29 show a flange above the shaft and a descending toe. Reconstruct upper-facing 12 mm pin flats, flange top 50 mm and staple top 74 mm; the former bottom flats and 31 mm clamp seat are superseded. M2092 has four HB221 occurrences. Its 160 mm length, 34 mm flange, 6.35 mm stock, 4 mm root fillet and two attachment holes are inferred. Upper supports remain partial, with hull attachment and SH294A covers unresolved; lower long runs and front inclination are now installed; exact sections, rear ownership and removable retention plates remain open. This does not establish a load path or structural performance.

idler_wheel_reconstruction.summary: Nested disk on the inboard rim attachment land and flatter diaphragm trough refine the HB87 section reading. All unprinted details remain inferred; five X and one Y diaphragms retain distinct identities with the same approximate shape. Narrow rims provisionally run on track bushings with 0.5 mm static clearance. Source center and screw-axis picks stay fixed; installed wheel/shaft moves along the inferred axis. Running engagement, load path, travel, X/Y shape distinction and historical fit remain unqualified. Foremost roller retains its explicit rearward offset and reported source-pick discrepancy.

idler_mount_reconstruction.summary: Partial M1474 shaft and M1472 adjustment installation. Printed screw length/diameter, nut across-flats and guard opening retained; shaft length is an unconfirmed drive-shaft transfer. Bracket, reinforcing plate, bores, thread envelopes, oil drilling, fastener profiles and installation topology are explicit inferred geometry. Guard is a provisional flush U bezel around the screw-head opening; its precise shape/retention is unlocated. Four M1484 plates modeled; only ten outer M1962/M1484 rivets positively allocated from SNL170. Inner plate attachments remain unresolved. Source axis from SNL2 picks [194,339] and [144,327] is held fixed; shaft moves along that axis for static track clearance. No tension, load-path, travel or historical-fit qualification.

lower_support_reconstruction.summary: 34 lower support angles and 76 short bolts follow SNL counts. Runs 1–3 are inclined through paired installed pins; runs 4/8 use horizontal seats with cubic transitions. Inner No5 M2176 serves Lower12 and M2175 serves Lower13–15 at fixed printed lengths. Run8 ownership of rear outlines27/28 is inferred. Unhanded source marks may have separate reflected construction variants; historical interchangeability is not established. 6.35mm stock, 34mm flange, run ends and drilling are inferred. Angle wall meets current 10mm skirt; plain tapped receiving holes are a working hypothesis. HB144 removable plates remain unidentified/unpopulated. No historical load, retention, manufacturing or continuous-rolling qualification.

front_skirt_border.summary: Lower-support receiver checks exposed missing material under the first bolt in the coarse front hull trace. Direct SNL2 inspection replaces the front lower border with retained source picks, +/-3px. Original profile remains hull_initial_layout. Middle/rear bottom contour and conservative transition beyond[509,562] remain partial; native track and rotating-part clearance must be checked rather than presuming a source trace establishes fit. Initial refined contour exposed four 20.621536mm3 track-rivet intersections at the foremost vertex. A separately recorded 6mm rearward vertex offset, approximately one source pixel, provides static clearance without modifying the source pick or image scale.

common_wheel_reconstruction.summary: Common M1403/M1404/M1405X/Y internals are reused in both idler and drive wheels. Disk radius 449 mm, rim land bore radius 415.925 mm, rim-rivet radius 430 mm, shortened diaphragm ends and 25 mm short-rivet radial pitch are explicit inferred interface choices, qualified only for native static geometry. The two 121-part common fixtures and four installed wheel study support this choice; oblique source views do not measure it. Local rim-rivet head overhang, formed profiles, X/Y distinctions and structural adequacy remain unresolved.

drive_wheel_reconstruction.summary: 35-tooth M1401 hypothesis follows original HB130/HB133; original HB119 9:37 remains contradictory. 39.237-inch OD, 32.75-inch ID and 2-inch tooth width are retained, but assigning the ID to the annular bore is provisional. Circular tooth reliefs, root radius, outer lip and crest rounding are inferred. Fixed SNL2 shaft axes are retained. Source wheel composition is populated; shafts, keys, nuts, bearings, retention, roller pinions and chain remain open. Static noninterference does not establish contact or continuous engagement. HB125 confirms nested lands and paired ring alignment. Inner-ring axial reversal preserves groove phase across the two track channels; the former X-axis flip staggered odd tooth counts and was rejected.
